packageRules.description: vite-7-template and vite-8-template pin @react-router/dev to the react-router 7.x line, whose typescript peer range is still ^5.1.0 || ^6.0.0, so keep these fixtures on typescript 6 until react-router 7.x supports typescript 7
vite-plus bundles an exact vitest version and hard-fails when the installed @vitest/coverage-* does not match it, so the whole Vite+ toolchain has to move in a single PR

vite-plus 0.3.3 bundles vitest 4.1.11 as an exact dependency and asserts the coverage provider matches it, so vitest 5 breaks `vp test --coverage`. Raise this ceiling once a vite-plus release bundles vitest 5
